fair_value.method: Blend (50/50) of forward P/E at the horizon (2028E adj EPS $10.50 x 25x = $262.50) and FCF yield (2028E FCF $3.8B at a 3.75% equity FCF yield / ~390M diluted shares = ~$260). Both haircut consensus ~4% for execution/timing slippage and the undisclosed UtilityInnovation deal economics.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: 2027E adj EPS $8.75 (consensus $9.10 less ~4%), grown 20% to 2028E $10.50 (the NTM year at the horizon) x 25x forward P/E

inputs_detail.derivation: 24/7 Wall St (Sept 3) cites $9.10; Koh's 28x 2027 at $253 implies ~$9.0, a cross-check

Consensus trimmed ~4%: Q2 revenue slipped on project timing (1), orders/backlog no longer disclosed so visibility is lower (3), and UtilityInnovation deal ($1.45B cash + up to $1.15B earnout) economics undisclosed, so lost interest income/dilution risk (6)

Decelerating from ~60% (2026) and ~30% (2027 consensus) as hyperscaler capex growth slows off a ~$1T 2027 base (15); supported by deferred revenue doubling to $3.63B and inventory up 73% in H1 2026 (2, 5) and SemiAnalysis delivered-MW acceleration (10)

Stock now ~36x 2026 / ~27x 2027 (3); TIKR cites 33.5x forward P/E at $263 (6). At the horizon growth will be lower (~20% vs ~35%) so I assume modest compression to 25x, still a premium to industrial peers for AI exposure

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: 2026 adj FCF guide $2.5B mid -> 2027E $3.2B -> 2028E $3.8B; 3.75% FCF yield -> ~$101B equity / ~390M diluted shares

inputs_detail.derivation: Grow FCF roughly with EPS: +28% in 2027 (in line with $6.70->$8.75) and +19% in 2028, minus working-capital drag from continued build
384.9M outstanding at 6/30/26; ~392.8M diluted; minor buyback offset
Cash $2.81B vs LT debt $2.94B; UIG $1.45B cash at close funded from cash/debt; treated as absorbed within the FCF yield rather than subtracted separately
At ~$98B market cap and 2026 FCF $2.5B the stock yields ~2.6% on current-year FCF (3); I require a higher 3.75% on NTM FCF at the horizon, consistent with EV/EBITDA compressing from ~25x (6)

bear.story: AI 'digestion' plays out (hyperscalers pause builds after the Sept-2026 frontier-AI slowdown calls); 2027 EPS lands ~$7.5 and 2028 growth flattens; with no backlog disclosure the market assumes the worst and pays ~20x trailing-ish earnings, near the 52-week low zone.

base.story: H2-2026 conversion delivers (Q3 guide $3.65-3.85B, Q4 ~ $4.3B), 2027 EPS ~$8.75-9.10, the multiple compresses to ~25x on 2028E as growth normalizes to ~20%; stock grinds modestly above today's price.

bull.story: Deferred revenue/inventory build proves a large backlog, management re-discloses orders, Vera Rubin/800V DC and UIG power content lift 2028 EPS to ~$12, and the multiple holds ~33x; stock retakes and exceeds the May-2026 high of ~$376-380.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$145 (under the 52-week low region of ~$134-138 plus buffer) the stock would be at ~16x consensus 2027 EPS, a level that only makes sense if orders have actually rolled over (hyperscaler capex cuts or real cancellations), not just timing slips; that would break the view that the doubled deferred revenue and inventory reflect a still-growing backlog.

Hyperscaler Q3 earnings calls: 2027 capex commentary after Sept AI-slowdown debate

key_uncertainties: True order/backlog trajectory: Vertiv stopped reporting orders and backlog after Feb 2026; deferred revenue ($1.8B -> $3.6B in H1 2026) is the best proxy
Whether the Sept-2026 frontier-AI slowdown debate turns into actual hyperscaler capex digestion in 2027
Project timing/supply-chain slippage recurring (Q2 revenue miss) and the heavy Q4-2026 back-end load
Economics and integration of UtilityInnovation and other acquisitions
Multiple compression as growth decelerates from ~60% to ~20%
reasoning: Alternative-lane read: independent newsletters (Koh, Monte, TOP1 Markets, TIKR) and Reddit trackers show sentiment split between 'fundamentals improving, stock de-rated' and 'visibility lost'. Facts: FY26 guide raised to $14.0B sales / $6.70 adj EPS / $2.5B FCF; consensus 2026 EPS rose ~26% YTD while the stock fell ~35% from the May high (~$376) on the July 29 Q2 revenue miss (-17%) and the mid-Sept AI slowdown sell-off (-19% in five sessions, triggered by AI lab leaders calling for a development slowdown; Gil Luria's 'hyperscalers can just digest' framing). The strongest unpriced-looking signal is on the 10-Q: deferred revenue doubled to $3.63B and inventory +73% in six months, which is hard to square with a demand problem and fits SemiAnalysis's view that real delays are in speculative, unordered projects; offsetting it, Currence/Network World data say 30-50% of 2026 capacity may slip, and the 'SEC investigation' in one newsletter is actually a plaintiff law-firm probe. Valuation at the horizon (~25x 2028E $10.50 and a 3.75% FCF yield) gives ~$260, only ~7% above spot, because I expect multiple compression to offset EPS growth. Scenarios $150/$270/$410 at 25/50/25 (mean ~$275, median ~$260). Ladder is a lognormal centered ~$258 with sigma ~0.56 (a bit under the 66% realized vol, since the stock already de-rated) and a slightly fatter left tail for an AI-capex digestion scenario. Note: one fetched page (Trefis) mentioned option-market figures unprompted; I disregarded them and did not cite it. Twelve Data estimates/targets were not available on the plan, so consensus came from press. Social/X sources were not directly reachable; Reddit sentiment via AltIndex only used as sentiment.
